summary_en: This Phase 1/Phase 2 study tests quemliclustat added to enfortumab vedotin and pembrolizumab for unresectable, locally advanced, or metastatic urothelial cancer of the bladder, renal pelvis, or ureter. All study drugs are given by IV infusion: quemliclustat on day 1, enfortumab vedotin on days 1 and 8, and pembrolizumab on day 1 of each 21-day cycle, for up to 2 years if the disease does not progress and side effects are acceptable. The study measures safety, side effects, and the best dose, and how well the combination works, but the primary outcome is not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/fase 2 evalúa quemliclustat añadido a enfortumab vedotina y pembrolizumab para el cáncer urotelial de vejiga, pelvis renal o uréter que no puede extirparse con cirugía, que está localmente avanzado o que es metastásico. Todos los medicamentos del estudio se administran por infusión intravenosa: quemliclustat el día 1, enfortumab vedotina los días 1 y 8, y pembrolizumab el día 1 de cada ciclo de 21 días, por hasta 2 años si la enfermedad no progresa y los efectos secundarios son aceptables. El estudio mide la seguridad, los efectos secundarios y la dosis más adecuada, y qué tan bien funciona la combinación, pero el resultado principal no está indicado.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older who give written informed consent
Previously untreated locally advanced or metastatic bladder, renal pelvis, or ureter urothelial cancer
Measurable disease by RECIST v1.1 criteria
Estimated life expectancy of at least 3 months, with blood, kidney, and liver lab values within required limits
not_for: Tumors with neuroendocrine, small cell, or other listed non-eligible histologies
Receiving other investigational agents or anticancer treatment, or without the required washout after surgery, radiation, or adjuvant immunotherapy
Systemic steroids within 10 days of enrollment (physiologic replacement allowed), or disease progression within 12 months after neoadjuvant or adjuvant therapy
Active autoimmune disease, active hepatitis B or C, HIV with CD4 below 350, QTcF above 480 ms, or leptomeningeal disease
Pregnancy, breastfeeding, or other conditions the investigator judges unsafe for participation
